newsitem.title: USA: Sri Lanka to tender for 100,000 T wheat -- trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka to tender for 100,000 T wheat -- trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka is expected to tender at the end of this month for 100,000 tonnes optional origin wheat, U.S. exporters said.
"The tender should go out on Nov 26," a U.S. exporter said.
The deal would include one lot of 50,000 tonnes soft white wheat slated for Dec 9-18 delivery and another 50,000 tonnes hard red wheat due for Jan 6-15 delivery, he said.
"I have heard that discussed," another U.S. exporter said. Exporters said the wheat could be from the U.S., Argentina, Australia, European Union and Canada.
